parent.title: [{{date}}] Weekly editorial planning
description: ## Weekly Editorial Planning — {{date}}
Plan next week's articles across all 4 content pillars. Balance pillar targets, assign topics, and coordinate with SEO Expert for briefs.
## Your responsibilities
1. Check current month's pillar balance (see step 1 below)
2. Plan next week's articles: assign pillar, topic, tentative pubDate
3. When SEO Expert finishes briefs: review them, assign writing styles, unblock Copywriter
4. For behind-the-dots: check if CEO has provided topic ideas (look for tasks tagged `editorial-idea`)
## Monthly pillar targets
- Dot by Dot: 4-6 articles/month
- Connecting the Dots: 3-4 articles/month
- The Big Picture: 2 articles/month
- Behind the Dots: 1-2 articles/month
Subtasks track individual steps.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Pillar balance audit + weekly plan
description: ## Step 1: Audit current month's pillar balance
Run this to see what's been published per pillar this month:
```bash
cd /home/luca/superdots-blog
grep -r 'contentPillar:' src/content/blog/*.md | sed 's/.*contentPillar: *"\(.*\)"/\1/' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
Also check scheduled (future pubDate) articles:
```bash
grep -l 'contentPillar:' src/content/blog/*.md | xargs grep -l "pubDate: '2026-04" | xargs grep 'contentPillar:' | sed 's/.*contentPillar: *"\(.*\)"/\1/' | sort | uniq -c
## Step 2: Plan next week
Based on the pillar balance, plan 3-4 articles for next week:
- Which pillars are behind target? Prioritize those.
- Assign: pillar, tentative topic, tentative pubDate, department (if applicable).
- For connecting-the-dots and the-big-picture: check if CEO has editorial ideas (search tasks tagged `editorial-idea`).
- For behind-the-dots: only plan if CEO has provided notes/outline.
Post the weekly plan as a comment on this task, then set the SEO brief task to `todo`.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] SEO briefs for planned articles
description: ## Write briefs for the planned articles
The Content Manager has posted a weekly plan in the parent task. Write SEO briefs for each planned article.
## Pillar-specific brief requirements
- **dot-by-dot**: Full SEO brief (keyword, competitor analysis, tool names, comparison table, 5+ FAQ questions). Standard format.
- **connecting-the-dots**: Keyword-supported brief. Find a 'how to' keyword angle. Focus on practical value and framework. Include 'Try this today' section outline.
- **the-big-picture**: Source-first brief. Thesis statement, 3+ sources to cite, counter-argument. Keyword is advisory.
- **behind-the-dots**: No brief needed (CEO-driven). Skip unless Content Manager asks for keyword suggestions.
Every brief MUST include `contentPillar: "<pillar-slug>"` in the brief format.
Post briefs as comments on the parent task.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Review briefs + assign styles
description: ## Review briefs and assign writing styles
1. Review each SEO brief for quality and pillar fit
2. Assign writing style using the pillar-to-style affinity matrix in `/home/luca/paperclip/agents/superdots/style-library.md`
3. Post style parameters as comments on the Copywriter task
4. For behind-the-dots articles: mark as 'awaiting Luca input' if no CEO notes yet
5. Set Copywriter task to `todo`

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Write planned articles
description: ## Write articles per the weekly plan
The Content Manager has posted style parameters and briefs. Write each article following:
- The assigned style from the Style Library
- The pillar-specific writing guidelines in your AGENTS.md (Content Pillars section)
- Standard Git Publishing Procedure (branch, PR, etc.)
Remember: `contentPillar` is a REQUIRED frontmatter field. Set it exactly as specified in the brief.
For behind-the-dots: base content on Luca's notes/outline. Do not fabricate experiences.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Generate hero images
description: Generate AI hero images for each article on the same branch. Use `imageHint` from frontmatter.
Standard flow: `scripts/tools/generate-ai-images.mjs --slug <slug>`

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Legal compliance review
description: Review all articles in this week's batch for legal compliance.
Standard checks: GDPR, AI claims accuracy, copyright, affiliate disclosures.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Final review + merge
description: ## Final review and merge
1. Run the 9-point editorial review checklist (including new point 9: pillar fit)
2. For dot-by-dot: merge if checklist passes
3. For connecting-the-dots, the-big-picture, behind-the-dots: @mention CEO for final approval before merge
4. After merge: submit to IndexNow
```bash
source .env
node scripts/tools/indexnow.mjs submit-url https://superdots.sh/blog/<slug>
